inputs.description:
One input per answer: selectors for the node verbs, search patterns for
`find`. Results align 1:1, in this order.

Options.description:
One superset of options; a verb reads what concerns it and ignores the rest,
so one request shape works everywhere — but an unknown KEY is still a typo
and still refuses.

color.description: `find`: keep only nodes of this reachability color.

kind.description: `find`: keep only this kind (a symbol kind, or `file`).

limit.description: Listing cap (default 50); every listing reports what it elided.

ReachColor.description:
The one projection of the three reachability floods into the color a
navigator speaks: `production` wins, then `test-only`, then `tooling-only`,
then `unreachable` — the same precedence the analyses' judgments imply.
